Problem Statement
Write a program to store student names and display only unique names using a HashSet.
Description
Read 5 student names and store them in a HashSet.
Perform the following operations:
Store all names in the HashSet.
Display the total number of unique names.
Check whether a given name exists in the set.
Display the result.
